title: SREV-322 Proc WerFault dump suppression boundary
stage: data -> schema -> topology -> logic -> action -> verify
contracts: WerFault dump suppression is local proc.c process-lifetime policy
WER dump configuration and in-process minidump writing are separate owners
the first WerFault process may be resumed and waited for dump capture
repeated WerFault processes may be terminated only after the exact WerFault predicate and duplicate-state gate
duplicate WerFault suppression terminates and waits but keeps PROCESS_INFORMATION handles caller-owned on the successful create path
runtime matrix must prove LocalDumps setup, WerFault launch count, dump file output, duplicate suppression, output handle behavior, negative controls, and EnableMiniDump regression
LocalDumps matrix must prove dump capture timing, duplicate WerFault lifetime, and caller-visible process/thread handle semantics before release
SREV-322 source path removes duplicate-path premature handle close while preserving first WerFault and non-WerFault resume behavior
shared user-mode lifecycle capture records must use feature_path werfault-localdumps-boundary

sandbox_configuration: blocked write access to dump folder
dump_output: no dump when WER LocalDumps is disabled
adjacency_regression: in-process dump output independent of WER LocalDumps
negative_controls: WerFault outside exact predicate is not suppressed
WER disabled or LocalDumps absent preserves ordinary process creation
dump folder ACL denial produces no dump output
fresh box first WerFault path is not duplicate-suppressed

runtime_gate: Windows WER LocalDumps crash matrix proving LocalDumps setup, WerFault launch count, dump file output, duplicate suppression, first-path and duplicate-path process/thread handle behavior, non-WerFault negative controls, WER-disabled negative controls, automatic-debugger negative controls, dump-folder ACL negative controls, and EnableMiniDump regression
